description: This PHP source file defines the PayGradeAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing pay grades within an HRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting pay grade records, utilizing various traits, validation rules, and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: PayGradeAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for managing PayGrade entities, including CRUD operations with validation, sorting, and pagination support, documented with OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all PayGrades with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new PayGrade record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove multiple PayGrade records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific PayGrade by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing PayGrade identified by ID.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Internal method to assign the name from request to PayGrade entity and persist it.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the request body, ensuring 'name' is provided and unique.
